class M(type):
 def __getattribute__(cls,name): yield name
class A(metaclass=M): pass
print(next(A.x))

class M(type):
 def __setattr__(cls,name,value):
  print("hook",name)
  return [7]
class A(metaclass=M): x=9
A.x=[7]
print(A.x)
type.__setattr__(7,"x",9)
type.__setattr__(int,"x",9)

class M(type):
 def __delattr__(cls,name):
  print("hook",name)
  return [7]
class A(metaclass=M): x=9
del A.x
print(A.x)
type.__delattr__(7,"x")
type.__delattr__(int,"x")
